title: Committed RSA private key is the IdentityServer token-signing key loaded in every deployment
owner_hint: no CODEOWNERS entry; top committer: Aditya Mandaleeka; component: Identity.API/
rationale: Removes the load path for the committed key rather than the binary file: deletes options.KeyManagement.Enabled = false (restoring Duende automatic key creation/rotation) and .AddDeveloperSigningCredential(), removes the csproj Content include that ships tempkey.jwk into build output, and gitignores tempkey*.jwk/rsa. OPERATOR ACTIONS outside the diff: git rm --cached the key, purge git history, treat kid F7383A0E... as compromised, and register a durable ISigningKeyStore or certificate-based AddSigningCredential before production.
variants_checked: Single AddDeveloperSigningCredential and KeyManagement occurrence repo-wide; no Dockerfiles (publish output is the only image vector, covered by the csproj change); no other .jwk references in code.
bypass_considered: Dirty checkouts/stale images still containing tempkey.jwk no longer reach the bad state — nothing loads it; residual exposure is key rotation/history, operational only.
test_note: Omitted — key-material loading has no testable branch in-repo; verify via JWKS endpoint key-id absence at deploy.
review_reason: All three hunks attack the same root cause at the exact load/ship paths; automatic key management replaces the static credential; no new surface; only incompleteness is the tracked-but-inert key file itself.
